description: Found during test-input research (docs/research/test-undeclared-inputs.md on jj bookmark research/test-undeclared-inputs (from turnkey-w55.3)), not yet verified at runtime. forge appears to auto-detect or download solc via svm under $HOME instead of using the toolchain's solc 0.8.34. It also merges ~/.foundry/foundry.toml if present, and fuzzes without a fixed seed. Verify which solc forge actually selects, and pin it (e.g. --use / --offline, FOUNDRY_* via the rule) so results depend only on declared inputs.
title: solidity_test may not use the Nix-provided solc
